Notifications.OnlyGM: Only the GM can generate loot chests.
Notifications.ChestsGenerated: {count} chest(s) generated successfully. Check the chat log for a summary (GM only).
Notifications.NoActiveScene: Chest "{name}" created, but no scene is open. Drag it from the Actors sidebar onto the map whenever you like.
Notifications.ChestPlaced: Chest "{name}" placed on the current scene.

Errors.PackNotFound: Compendium pack "{pack}" not found. Is the Daggerheart system active?
Errors.TableNotFound: RollTable "{name}" not found in the Daggerheart rolltables compendium.
Errors.DialogFailed: Could not open the chest generation dialog. See console for details.

Dialog.Title: Generate Loot Chest — Daggerheart
Dialog.DiceModeHint: Uniform gives every item in that rarity's range an equal chance and never exceeds it. Bell curve favors results in the middle of the range, but can occasionally reach a bit into the next rarity up.
Dialog.ArmorCountLabel: Armor pieces rolled from this Tier
Dialog.PlaceOnSceneLabel: Automatically place at the center of the current scene
Dialog.Hint: Tip: the values above are pre-filled with the suggested defaults for the selected Tier, but you can freely adjust them before generating.
Dialog.ForSaleLabel: Put up for sale (a merchant sells the contents at the counter)

Shop.Title: Consumables Shop — Daggerheart
Shop.Hint: Check the consumables (from the system compendium) and how many of each. Players drag them from the shop sheet onto their character.

Trade.SellHint: Open the counter to buy what she has, or drag items from your sheet here to sell them.
Trade.MerchantEnabled: "{name}" is now a merchant. Players can see the sheet and trade at the counter.
Trade.MerchantDisabled: "{name}" is no longer a merchant. The previous permission was restored.
Trade.CustomerChanged: The counter now belongs to {name}; the other character's items for sale were removed.
Trade.DropHere: Drag items from your sheet here to sell them.
Trade.BuyHint: Use the + in the stock below to pick what to buy.
Trade.DoneEven: Trade done with {merchant}, no money involved.

Warn.DropFromSheet: Drag the item from your character sheet.
Warn.NotYourItem: You can only sell items from a sheet you own.
Warn.NotSellable: "{name}" is not an inventory item (weapon, armor, consumable or loot).
Warn.OneSeller: This counter already holds items for sale from {name}. Confirm or clear it before selling as another character.

Errors.NoGM: No GM connected: a trade needs the GM online.
Errors.NoCustomer: Choose the character making the trade.
Errors.Timeout: The GM didn't answer in time. Nothing was moved.
Errors.Missing: Could not find the merchant or the character.
Errors.NotMerchant: This chest is no longer for sale.
Errors.NotGM: Only the GM can complete a trade.
Errors.NothingToTrade: Nothing in this trade has a price with the merchant.
Errors.MerchantBroke: The merchant doesn't have the gold to pay {total}.
Errors.MerchantBrokeShort: The merchant doesn't have enough gold to pay the difference.
Errors.CustomerBroke: {name} doesn't have the gold to pay {total}.
Errors.CustomerBrokeShort: Your character doesn't have enough gold to pay the difference.
Errors.Failed: The trade failed. Check the GM's console. {error}

Prices.Title: Price list — {name}
Prices.DefaultIntro: Used by every chest for sale that has no list of its own, including the ones you generate marked "for sale".
Prices.UsesDefault: This chest uses the default list. Saving here creates a list just for it.
Prices.UnitHint: Values in handfuls of gold (10 handfuls = 1 bag, 10 bags = 1 chest). 0 = she doesn't trade the item that way.
Prices.UnitHintCoins: Values in handfuls of gold (10 coins = 1 handful, 10 handfuls = 1 bag, 10 bags = 1 chest); use decimals for coins. 0 = she doesn't trade the item that way.
Prices.PurseHint: Unchecked, the merchant pays from the gold on her own sheet (refusing what she can't afford) and keeps what she receives. Checked, her gold never changes.
Prices.DefaultsHint: Price per unit. Weapons and armor use the item's Tier; consumables and loot items use their rarity in the system's tables (Common = Tier 1 … Legendary = Tier 4).
Prices.OverridesHint: Drag items (from a compendium, the sidebar or a sheet) to give them their own prices. An empty field follows the default; 0 = she doesn't trade it.
